lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to buy a linen loincloth and wear it, and Jeremiah does so.
The LORD sends Jeremiah to Babylon to hide the loincloth in a crevice of the rocks.
Many days later Jeremiah digs up the loincloth, and it is ruined and of no use at all.
The LORD says He will ruin the pride of Judah and Jerusalem, who did not listen to Him.
The LORD says He will fill the people with oil and spare the kings who sit on David's throne.

wrong_details.true: fill all who live in the land with drunkenness
